title: We Are The Boredom Modpack
description: The modpack used to host the We Are The Boredom Minecraft server.
body:
## We Are The Boredom Modpack
### The modpack that is used to host the We Are The Boredom Minecraft server. It includes many QOL and performance features for all server sizes, with more to come over time!

**Description:** This pack is meant to elevate the vanilla experience with many grindy parts of the game made easier, ex. math-accurate crafting,  and server utilities, ex. permission manager and logging. Better yet, it is Bedrock compatible *(minus some custom resources, which will be added for 1.21.5)* so that anyone can play on your server!

<details>
<summary>Some Features</summary>

* Warps (Servercore)
* Bots (carpet mod)
* Discord Intagration
* Server Map (Blue map)
* Better Crafts (T's Craft Fixes)
* Higher Trident Chance (CEMD)
* Faster Trading (Faster Trading)
* And many more!

</details>

<details>
<summary>Server Setup</summary>

For server setup, make sure to check the configs of:
* Bluemap
* Discord Intagration
* Luckperms
* Simple Voice Chat
* Server Replay

For the optimal experience.\
Other than this setup, which is outlined in their respective documentation, the pack is drag and drop.

</details>

**Performance:** On an I5-6500 with 16GB of RAM (12GB dedicated) it can handle 8 players in separate locations with a few auto farms running before losing TPS. I do recommend a better CPU for higher player counts or more AFK farming.  

*Gallary images will not be added as there are no major graphical changes made by this pack. My [texture pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ts-textures) has more images of the custom items.*
